description: Collins: 60 ml gin, 30 ml lemon (1.0 parts), 15 ml syrup (0.5), 60 ml soda (2.0). Sour and soda fit the optional mixer slot of the Daiquiri; the Highball has the soda but its squeeze slot ends at 0.37, so the 1.0 parts of juice are above it (distance 1.0 / 0.37 - 1 = 1.7027) and the book's filing under the Daiquiri holds.
source: docs/templates.md#vectors; expected values worked out by hand from the slot bands in data/templates (assumptions, see the document)
